text:
jordan: Quick Q — our CI job for payments needs a temp sandbox API key. Should we store the ephemeral key as a CI env var, put it in Vault as a KV, or use dynamic creds? worried about logs and who has rotation/ownership.

maria: Use Vault dynamic creds if the third party supports it. If not, put it in Vault KV with a short TTL and access policy scoped to the CI role. Avoid permanent plaintext in CI env. :lock:

alex: +1 to Vault agent injection. We can run a init step that fetches the secret and exports it for the job, e.g.:

```
# fetch into ephemeral file and export
PAYMENT_API_KEY=$(vault kv get -field=token secret/ci/payment/staging)
export PAYMENT_API_KEY
```

Make sure the CI runner masks the env var in logs.

sam: If you can't use Vault, use the CI provider's secrets store with per-job tokens and set mask=true. Also add `set +x` where necessary to avoid accidental echo.

maria: Rotation/ownership: security owns policy + escalation. App/service team owns the credential lifecycle (creation, rotation cadence) unless it's a platform-managed token. For one-offs we require a documented TTL and a ticket in #incidents if it extends past TTL.

dan: Need a short exception: one-off run tomorrow that fetches keys from a partner that only issues long-lived tokens. Can we get approval to store it in a temp KV for 48h?

maria: We can approve but need: (1) ticket with justification, (2) explicit list of readers (IAM policy), (3) TTL set to 48h and an automated destroy job, (4) confirm logs masked. Please ping me and @alex for platform changes.

sec-bot: Policy link: https://intranet.redwood/security/secrets-policy — follow "CI & ephemeral secrets" section. :page_with_curl:

jordan: Thanks — i'll open a ticket with justification + add the reader list. i'll wire up vault-agent init step and add `set +x` around the fetch. tagging @maria for final sign-off. :thumbsup:

maria: Sounds good. Also, if you need HSM-wrapped private keys for signing, escalate — we have an HSM import flow but that is slower. For API tokens Vault + short TTL is preferred.

jordan: noted, will avoid HSM unless signing keys. ETA: i'll have PR and ticket in the next 3 hours.

alex: If you want me to add a CI mask rule I can do it once PR links the ticket.

jordan: Perfect, thanks all.
